Sharada Promoters And Builders vs Special Land Acquisition
Officer No 11 ... on 11 December, 2023
Author: B. P. Colabawalla

Bench: B. P. Colabawalla
 3
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
 Writ Petition No. 12660 Of 2023
 Sharada Promoters & Builders 
 Versus
 Special Land Acquisition Officer No.11 Collector
 Officer & Ors 
 Mr. Yuvraj Narvankar, Advocates for the Petitioner.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ms. N.M. Mehra, Agp, for Respondent-State.

Coram : B. P. Colabawalla &
 Somasekhar Sundaresan, Jj.

1 .  The above Writ Petition is filed inter alia seeking a declaration that retention of an amount towards nazarana is illegal and bad in law and non est and a direction to Respondent No. 1 to release the entire amount of compensation in favour of the Petitioners.
The above Writ Petition is coming up for the first time.

2. Ms. Mehra, the learned AGP waives notice on behalf of Digitally Respondent Nos. 1 to 4 and 6 and request for three weeks time to file signed by ASHWINI ASHWINI JANARDAN JANARDAN VALLAKATI VALLAKATI

sentences.text: In these circumstances, the State is directed to file a reply on or before 3rd January 2024 and serve a copy of the same on the Advocates for the Petitioner.

The Registry is directed to issue notice to the Respondent No. 5, returnable on 10th January 2024.
4. Stand over to 10th January 2024.
5. This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.

opennyai_summary.decision:
1 .  The above Writ Petition is filed inter alia seeking a declaration that retention of an amount towards nazarana is illegal and bad in law and non est and a direction to Respondent No. 1 to release the entire amount of compensation in favour of the Petitioners.
In these circumstances, the State is directed to file a reply on or before 3rd January 2024 and serve a copy of the same on the Advocates for the Petitioner.
